# External Integrations

**Analysis Date:** 2026-11-03

The site is a static, zero-backend single-page app (`docs/architecture.md`). At runtime it makes no network requests beyond same-origin assets. External systems appear at build time (GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages), as outbound links, and as a `mailto:` link.

## APIs & External Services

**Runtime API calls:**
- None. No `fetch`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, or `sendBeacon` usage in `src/`.

**Outbound links (rendered as anchors, user-initiated):**
- GitHub profile - `https://github.com/aa-phan` in `src/content/contacts.ts`
- LinkedIn profile - `https://www.linkedin.com/in/aa-phan/` in `src/content/contacts.ts`
- Instagram profile - `https://www.instagram.com/phvntm_` in `src/content/contacts.ts`
  - Brand icons are inline SVG: `src/components/ui/icons/GitHubIcon.tsx`, `LinkedInIcon.tsx`, `InstagramIcon.tsx` (ADR-0005)
- Project source repository - `https://github.com/aa-phan/RecipeCart` in `src/content/projects.ts` (`links.code`)
- Email - `mailto:owner@example.invalid` in `index.html` (hero "Copy email" CTA) and the contact section data
  - Copy path: `copyText` in `src/lib/copy.ts` writes through `navigator.clipboard.writeText`, falling back to `document.execCommand('copy')`, and finally to `openMail` (`window.location.href = href`).

**Content rule:** Every external link in content must be `https` (checked by content tests per `docs/architecture.md`). The phone number must never appear in the site (`scripts/check-no-phone.mjs`).

## Data Storage

**Databases:**
- None. Content is typed TypeScript data in `src/content/` (`profile.ts`, `experience.ts`, `projects.ts`, `skills.ts`, `education.ts`, `contacts.ts`), validated by `src/content/schema.ts` and assembled in `src/content/index.ts`.

**File Storage:**
- Local filesystem only, in the repo:
  - `public/resume.pdf` - served as a static download. Linked via `import.meta.env.BASE_URL` in `src/sections/Hero/Hero.tsx`, `src/sections/Contact/Contact.tsx`, `src/layout/PillNav.tsx`, `src/layout/SiteHeader.tsx`.
  - `src/assets/images/` - imported as modules and hashed by Vite. Variants generated by vite-imagetools.
  - `public/favicon.svg` - referenced from `index.html`.
- Image checks (`scripts/check-images.mjs`) enforce AVIF/WebP output and no EXIF/XMP metadata in shipped rasters.

**Caching:**
- None on the server side. Hashed asset filenames give long-lived browser caching by design (`docs/architecture.md`).
- Client storage only: `localStorage` key `theme` (`THEME_STORAGE_KEY` in `src/lib/theme.ts`). Reads and writes are wrapped in try/catch so blocked storage degrades to a session-only choice.

## Authentication & Identity

**Auth Provider:**
- Not applicable. The site has no accounts, login, or visitor identity.

## Fonts & Static Third-Party Assets

- Archivo variable font self-hosted via `@fontsource-variable/archivo` (`src/main.tsx` imports `@fontsource-variable/archivo/wdth.css`). No Google Fonts or other font CDN, per `docs/architecture.md`.
- No third-party scripts, analytics snippets, tag managers, or embedded iframes are present in `index.html`, `404.html`, or `src/`.

## Monitoring & Observability

**Error Tracking:**
- None. No Sentry, Bugsnag, or similar SDK is installed.

**Analytics:**
- None detected.

**Logs:**
- Not applicable on the client. Build and verification scripts print to stdout/stderr (`scripts/*.mjs`).

## CI/CD & Deployment

**Hosting:**
- GitHub Pages, project site for the repo `aa-phan-portfolio-v2` (staging, `VITE_BASE=/aa-phan-portfolio-v2/`). Cutover target is the user site `aa-phan.github.io` (`VITE_BASE=/`), per `docs/deploy-runbook.md` and `docs/adr/0003-github-pages-source-and-cutover.md`.
- The `deploy.yml` workflow uses `actions/deploy-pages` v5.0.1 in environment `github-pages` (OIDC via `id-token: write`).

**CI Pipeline:**
- GitHub Actions. Two workflows:
  - `.github/workflows/ci.yml` - Triggered on `push` and `pull_request`. Runs on `ubuntu-latest`: `npm ci`, `npm run verify`, `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`, `npm run test:e2e`.
  - `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` - Triggered on `push` to `main` and `workflow_dispatch`. Jobs: `build` (verify, `configure-pages`, `upload-pages-artifact` of `./dist`), `e2e` (needs build; runs Playwright on a fresh build), `deploy` (needs build and e2e; `deploy-pages`, then a `curl` check that the live page contains "Aaron Phan").
- Actions are pinned by commit SHA with the version in a trailing comment:
  - `actions/checkout` v7.0.1 (`3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1`)
  - `actions/setup-node` v7.1.0 (`949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1`)
  - `actions/configure-pages` v6.0.0 (`45bfe0192ca1faeb007ade9deae92b16b8254a0d`)
  - `actions/upload-pages-artifact` v5.0.0 (`fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9`)
  - `actions/deploy-pages` v5.0.1 (`368f82528645a54fb793d4d04e342629a3f51346`)
- Permissions: workflow default `contents: read`. `pages: read` only on the build job; `pages: write` and `id-token: write` only on the deploy job.
- Concurrency: `ci-${{ github.ref }}` with cancel-in-progress in CI; group `pages` with cancel-in-progress disabled for deploys.
- Dependency sources in CI: npm registry (via `npm ci`) and the Playwright browser CDN (via `npx playwright install`). The browser download is not covered by the lockfile or the SHA pins, and it runs in its own job so it never shares a job with the uploaded artifact.

**Repository tooling:**
- `gh` CLI is used for PR and Pages checks as described in `docs/deploy-runbook.md`. No other external CI/CD service is configured.

## Environment Configuration

**Required env vars (build time):**
- `VITE_SITE_ORIGIN` - Required. The build throws when it is empty (`vite.config.ts`). It sets canonical, `og:url`, and sitemap origin. Not set in either workflow file and no `.env` is present in the working tree; supply it locally in `.env` or in the environment, and add it to the workflows if CI is expected to build.
- `VITE_BASE` - Set by both workflows to `/aa-phan-portfolio-v2/`. Defaults to `/` locally.

**Optional env vars:**
- `JS_BUDGET_BYTES` - Overrides the 150 kB gzipped initial-JS budget.
- `E2E_BASE_URL` - Runs Playwright against a live URL instead of starting a local preview server.

**Secrets location:**
- No application secrets are referenced. The workflows use only `actions/*` steps, the implicit `GITHUB_TOKEN`, and OIDC for the Pages deploy. No repository secrets appear in `.github/workflows/`.
- No `.env` file is present in the tree. `.gitignore` does not list `.env`, so a local `.env` with `VITE_SITE_ORIGIN` would not be ignored by git; keep personal contact details out of any committed file (the deploy runbook records a history rewrite done for this reason).

## Webhooks & Callbacks

**Incoming:**
- None. No server endpoints exist.

**Outgoing:**
- None. No webhook calls are made from the app or the build.

## Post-Deploy Verification Calls

- `deploy.yml` performs one outbound `curl -fsS --retry 6` to the deployed `page_url` and greps for "Aaron Phan" (CI-only, not part of the shipped app).
- `playwright.config.ts` targets `http://localhost:4173<base>` locally, or `E2E_BASE_URL` when set. The E2E suite navigates the built site; it does not call third-party APIs.
